report_level_evaluation.design: 20-minute tutorial, 10-minute free use, 18 questions across seven categories; query/answer correctness and time recorded.

report_level_evaluation.results: Not reported; limits: No comparator or randomized efficacy trial reported; short trained-session evidence. Eighteen questions are not participants.
